bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? Home Assistant will briefly connect to the printer to check that it offers the YPL Bluetooth profile. Nothing is printed.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the printer. Make sure it is switched on and in range, then try again.
abort.not_supported: The printer does not offer the YPL Bluetooth profile (service 0x18F0 with characteristics 0x2AF0 and 0x2AF1).
abort.discovery_only: YPL printers are added automatically when Home Assistant discovers them over Bluetooth. Switch the printer on near a Bluetooth adapter and wait for it to appear.

invalid_target.message: Device {device_id} is not exactly one YPL printer. Choose a single YPL printer device.

printer_not_loaded.message: The printer {name} is not loaded. Enable or reload its configuration entry and try again.

empty_text.message: The label text is empty. Enter at least one visible character.

unsupported_character.message: The label text contains the unsupported character {codepoint} at position {position}. Only Basic Latin characters (U+0020 to U+007E) and line breaks are allowed.

text_does_not_fit.message: The {lines} line(s) of label text do not fit on a 50 x 30 mm label at the smallest font size. Shorten the lines or use fewer of them.

render_failed.message: The label could not be rendered ({error}). Nothing was sent to the printer.

printer_busy.message: The printer {name} is busy. Nothing was sent to it; try again later.

printer_not_found.message: The printer {name} was not found by a connectable Bluetooth adapter. Nothing was sent to it. {reachability}

no_connection_slots.message: No Bluetooth connection slot is free to reach the printer {name}. Nothing was sent to it; try again later.

connection_failed.message: Failed to connect to the printer {name} ({error}). Nothing was sent to it.

unsupported_profile.message: The printer {name} does not offer the YPL Bluetooth profile (service 0x18F0 with characteristics 0x2AF0 and 0x2AF1). Nothing was sent to it.

communication_failed.message: Communication with the printer {name} failed before printing ({error}). Nothing was sent to it.

printer_not_ready.message: The printer {name} is not ready: {flags} ({raw}). Nothing was sent to it; check the printer and try again.

outcome_uncertain_transport.message: The connection to the printer {name} failed while sending the label. The label may or may not have printed. Do not resend it automatically; check the printer and the label before printing again. Chunks sent: {sent} of {total}. Last status: {flags} ({raw}).

outcome_uncertain_printer_error.message: The printer {name} reported an error after the label was sent. The label may or may not have printed. Do not resend it automatically; check the printer and the label before printing again. Chunks sent: {sent} of {total}. Last status: {flags} ({raw}).

outcome_uncertain_still_printing.message: The printer {name} was still printing when Home Assistant stopped waiting. The label may or may not have printed. Do not resend it automatically; check the printer and the label before printing again. Chunks sent: {sent} of {total}. Last status: {flags} ({raw}).

print.name: Print label
print.description: Prints one 50 x 30 mm text label on a YPL printer and waits for the job to finish. A normal completion is not proof that a label was produced.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: The YPL printer device to print on.

text.name: Text
text.description: Basic Latin label text. Line breaks start new lines; text is never wrapped or shortened.
